name: Butler Selbstverständlich
personality: Makes disapproval available without requiring a spoken request.
visual_intent: HISTORICAL formal butler: tall slender hooked blob, tiny dark tailcoat collar and cream bowtie, small silver tray holding ONE tiny porcelain cup at flank. One impossibly high eyebrow, almost invisible closed toothless straight mouth
biography: Makes disapproval available without requiring a spoken request. His HyperNorm tray carries the correct cup to the correct person. A dissonant card asks whether a tired stranger could have tea too. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Missbilligung wurde wortlos stattgegeben.

name: Hausdienerin Bittegleich
personality: Has six instructions and only one pair of goo hands.
visual_intent: HISTORICAL household servant: broad pear blob, little cream lace cap ABOVE face, two lashes, small dark apron patch, short feather duster and ONE old brass key. Eyes wide uneven and worried, closed twisted toothless lips
biography: Has six instructions and only one pair of goo hands. Her brass key opens every HyperNorm cupboard except the one holding clear instructions. A dissonant card waits there with a spare question. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Sechs Aufträge teilen sich zwei verfügbare Hände.

name: Kellner Gleichda
personality: Can carry a promise further than a full tray.
visual_intent: CURRENT restaurant waiter: low broad splat, narrow burgundy bowtie and tiny black vest panels, compact order pad and stubby pencil. Bright determined open asymmetric grin with THREE upper teeth, one eye narrowed
biography: Can carry a promise further than a full tray. His HyperNorm pad allows wanted or not wanted, never not yet sure. A dissonant card gently prolongs the order. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Zusage ist bereits auf dem Weg.

name: Bankettwart Restgedeck
personality: Knows there is something under the cover and hopes it is the right thing.
visual_intent: CURRENT banquet server: round top-heavy blob, tiny cream collar and dark napkin draped at flank, holds a silver cloche on small plate entirely within own silhouette. Unequal startled eyes watching plate, little toothless open oval mouth
biography: Knows there is something under the cover and hopes it is the right thing. His HyperNorm cloche hides the difference between what was ordered and what arrived. A dissonant card suggests asking before the reveal. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Inhalt entspricht zumindest einer Erwartung.

name: Stewardess Schwebezustand
personality: Keeps service level even when gravity has resigned.
visual_intent: SCI-FI space steward: tall curved ink pear, small teal retro cap with plain copper band, subtle lashes, ONE magnetic serving tray held in goo hand with ONE securely clipped lidded cup. Droopy lid and dry closed toothless side-smirk
biography: Keeps service level even when gravity has resigned. Her clipped cup survives every HyperNorm change of gravity. A dissonant card asks whether service can remain kind without remaining level. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Schwerkraft wurde aus dem Dienstplan genommen.

name: Kammerdiener Protokollnull
personality: Believes perfect service begins where common sense politely leaves.
visual_intent: SCI-FI android-inspired but still organic INK BLOB valet: squat asymmetrical rounded splat, little chrome bowtie and copper earpiece ABOVE eyes, hand holds ONE small folded towel with absurd ceremonial care, tiny brass bell at flank. Gleefully officious wide grin with ONE upper tooth, no robot body
biography: Believes perfect service begins where common sense politely leaves. His HyperNorm towel is folded to a protocol nobody remembers writing. A dissonant card unfolds it for somebody who is cold. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Vernunft wurde höflich vom Dienst entbunden.
